products.body_html:
Corsair Frame 4000D Wood RS Black Mid Tower Tempered Glass PC Cabinet

Real wood front panel for a natural aesthetic

4x RS120 PWM fans for effective low-noise cooling

Fully-modular design for next-level customization

InfiniRail™ Fan Mounting System for easier building

3x 360mm radiator mounting locations

Built-in GPU Anti-sag Stabilization Arm

Compatible with reverse-connector motherboards

NATURALLY COOLER

NATURAL WOOD FRONT PANEL

The FRAME 4000D WOOD RS lets you create a standout build that blends right in thanks to a refined front panel featuring real wood for the perfect mix of style and cooling performance.

BUILD YOUR WAY

EXPANSIVE MODULAR POSSIBILITIES

The revolutionary FRAME Modular Case System redefines customization by offering a modular design with an array of easily-swappable parts so you can customize the look and performance of your PC.

FAN FOCUSED

CORSAIR INFINIRAIL FAN MOUNTING SYSTEM

This steel multi-point mounting system provides unmatched flexibility for front and roof fan configurations. Easily slide the rail to mount fans up to 200mm (140mm in the roof) exactly where you need them, ensuring targeted airflow without limitations of fixed mounting points.

BUILD AND CHILL

THREE 360mm RADIATOR MOUNTS

Customize your cooling with three dedicated mounting locations for 360mm radiators in the front, roof, or side. Mount up to dual 360mm radiators simultaneously while still having space for additional intake/exhaust fans for extra cooling performance.

GO WITH THE FLOW

FOUR RS120 PWM FANS INCLUDED

RS120 PWM fans feature daisy-chainable connections for easy setup. Their magnetic dome bearings minimize friction, delivering a perfect combination of high airflow and quiet operation.

FUTURE PROOF

A BREEZE TO BUILD IN

With a modern design approach to a mainstream PC format, the FRAME 4000D WOOD RS has the convenient features to take the hassle out of your build.

WIDE COOLING FLEXIBILITY

Customize your cooling setup with room for up to 13x 120mm fans, plus versatile radiator mounting options including up to dual 360mm radiators

products.title: Corsair FRAME 4000D LCD RS ARGB - White - CS-CC-9011327-WW
products.body_html:
FRAME 4000D LCD RS ARGB Premium Mid-Tower PC Case

XENEON EDGE 14.5" LCD Touchscreen pre-installed

4x RS120 PWM ARGB Fans for powerful cooling

Modern Front I/O panel with 3x USB Type-C ports

InfiniRail™ Fan Mounting System for superior cooling

Compatibility with reverse connector motherboards

BUILD YOUR DREAM MACHINE

This leveled-up version of the FRAME 4000D includes a host of upgrades for peak performance with a pre-installed XENEON EDGE 14.5" LCD Touchscreen, more cooling power, updated front panel I/O, and increased rigidity for the ultimate mid-tower chassis.

FOUR POWERFUL RS120 ARGB FANS INCLUDED

The FRAME 4000D LCD provides full system cooling right out of the box with three RS120 ARGB intake fans and one RS120 ARGB exhaust fan for powerful cooling with very low-noise and customizable lighting. A new 120mm/140mm fan mount has been added to the bottom of the chassis as well, giving builders even more options for fan placement.

CORSAIR INFINIRAIL™ FAN MOUNTING SYSTEM

The steel multi-point mounting system provides unmatched flexibility for front and roof fan configurations. Easily slide the rail between 120mm and 140mm fan sizes and adjust the fan locations to ensure targeted airflow without limitations of fixed mounting points.

MODERN FRONT PANEL I/O

Puts your connections within easy reach, including a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port with 20Gb/s of bandwidth, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C ports with 5Gb/s of bandwidth, and a combination audio/microphone jack.

DUAL 360mm RADIATOR SUPPORT

Boost your cooling with three dedicated mounting locations for 360mm radiators—front, roof, and side. You can mount up to 13x 120mm fans simultaneously, ensuring continuous cool air intake and efficient hot air exhaust.

LOOK, NO CABLES

The case is fully compatible with motherboards with backside connections and works with ASUS BTF, MSI Project Zero, and GIGABYTE Project Stealth motherboards. It features ample connector and cable cutouts along with plenty of tie-downs to keep your build neat and organized.

WIDE COOLING FLEXIBILITY

Customize your cooling setup with room for up to 13x 120mm fans, plus versatile radiator mounting options including up to dual 360mm radiators. Install a GPU up to 405mm, even with fans installed in the front.

* For Compatibly of the product, please visit the respective product web site.

* Compatibility issues are not covered under warranty or return.

*To be eligible for a return in case of a change of mind or product damage, customers are required to video record the unboxing of the package.

products.title: Corsair 9000D RGB AIRFLOW Super-Tower Case - White - CS-CC-9011274-WW
products.body_html:
CORSAIR 9000D RGB AIRFLOW Super Full-Tower PC Case

The CORSAIR iCUE LINK 9000D RGB AIRFLOW Super Full-Tower Case offers immense space, superior cooling capacity, and design innovations to support the build of your dreams.

Supports up to 18x 120mm fans

Fits up to 480mm radiators

InfiniRail™ fan mounting system

iCUE LINK System Hub

Accommodates up to 6x SSDs and 5x HDDs

QuikTurn™ screws, integrated GPU anti-sag, a microfiber, and more

Compatible with ASUS BTF, MSI Project Zero, and Gigabyte Project Stealth reverse connection motherboards

BUILT FOR AMBITION

The 9000D RGB AIRFLOW builds on the legacy of CORSAIR’s award-winning case design and introduces a host of new innovations that make it even easier to build your magnum opus.

INCREDIBLE COOLING CAPACITY

A cavernous interior supports an extensive range of cooling configurations, accommodating up to 18x 120mm, 7x 140mm, or 4x 200mm fans.

Mount radiators up to 480mm in the front and roof, 360mm in the side, and 240mm in the rear for unmatched custom cooling loops.

INFINIRAIL FAN MOUNTING SYSTEM

This multi-point mounting system offers unmatched flexibility for front and roof fan configurations.

Simply slide the rail to mount 120mm and 140mm fans in any position, ensuring targeted airflow without fixed vertical mounting constraints.

OPTIMIZED FOR AIRFLOW

An improved high-airflow steel front panel, now removable for easy cleaning, takes in all the cool air you need to keep your top-of-the-line components performing at their best.

INTEGRATED USB TYPE-C HUB

The front panel features an integrated USB Type-C hub that allows you to take full advantage of the case’s I/O panel regardless of your motherboard’s capabilities. The integrated DAC drives the front panel audio ports for a premium experience.

BUILT FOR BUILDERS

30mm of clearance behind the motherboard tray provides ample space to route all your cables, and a removable hard drive cage offers additional flexibility to accommodate sprawling custom-cooled setups.

A JOY TO BUILD IN

The 9000D RGB AIRFLOW incorporates the latest cutting-edge designs and features to make building easier and more intuitive.

MODERN FRONT PANEL I/O

The front panel features an integrated USB Type-C hub that streamlines connectivity and offers 2x USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C and 4x USB 3.2 Gen-1 Type-A ports.

products.body_html:
iCUE LINK 3500X RGB Mid-Tower PC Case

The CORSAIR iCUE LINK 3500X RGB Mid-Tower Glass PC Case combines builder-friendly features with a stunning wraparound glass aesthetic and three pre-installed iCUE LINK RX120 RGB fans.

Includes

Wraparound glass view with removable front and side panels

3x Pre-installed iCUE LINK RX120 fans with iCUE LINK System Hub

Builder-friendly features for a high-performance custom PC

Side, roof, and PSU fan mounting points for great cooling 

Compatible with reverse connector motherboards including ASUS BTF, MSI PROJECT ZERO, and GIGABYTE PROJECT STEALTH

BUILD WITHOUT BOUNDARIES

You don’t need a large footprint to build a decked-out PC. The 3500X accommodates most large graphics cards and CPU coolers, 360mm radiators, and even EATX motherboards – without taking up your entire desk.

For a truly immaculate build, the 3500X is compatible with most reverse connector motherboards (including ASUS BTF, MSI PROJECT ZERO, and GIGABYTE PROJECT STEALTH) keeping your connections and cables out of sight.

INCLUDES iCUE LINK RX RGB PERFORMANCE FANS

An included iCUE LINK System Hub and three RX RGB fans make this case a ready-to-build marvel within a revolutionary ecosystem. iCUE LINK eradicates cable clutter, transforming your build into a showcase of elegance. 

RX Series fans represent a pinnacle of engineering, incorporating CORSAIR Magnetic Dome bearings, AirGuide technology, and in-house fan blade development optimized for unparalleled cooling efficiency in both radiator and PC case applications.  

COOLING PERFORMANCE

Strong cooling is paramount for a modern PC, and the 3500X excels with side, roof, and PSU fan mounts so you can cover all the angles. And with 360mm radiator mounting points in the side and roof, you’ll have plenty of potential for liquid cooling.

A BREEZE TO BUILD IN

With a modern design approach to a mainstream PC format, the 3500X has the convenient features to take the hassle out of your build.

WIDE COOLING FLEXIBILITY

Customize your cooling setup with room for up to 10x 120mm fans, plus versatile radiator mounting options including up to 360mm in the side and roof.

MODERN FRONT PANEL I/O

Puts your connections within easy reach, including a USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C Port, 2x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A ports, and a combination audio/microphone jack.
